name: How long does the custom built-in installation process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the custom built-in installation process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom built-in installation depends on the project's scope, from design and material selection to fabrication and final installation. Smaller projects might be completed within a few weeks, while larger, more complex units could take several months. A key factor in expediting the process is having clear decisions on materials, finishes, and design details early on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation timelines for custom built-ins vary from weeks to months, depending on the project's scope and design complexity.
